scope_note: Source/rights audit only. No images, video or full archives are acquired. Measured FGVC values come from the 407,927-byte annotations-only archive, inspected outside the repository and deleted afterwards. See docs/dataset.md.

sources.name: FGVC-Aircraft 2013b
sources.provenance: Oxford VGG release; photographs from airliners.net contributors; Maji et al. 2013, arXiv:1306.5151.

rights.terms_summary: Images for non-commercial research purposes only; photographers retain copyright and must be contacted for other use.

availability_reason.fixed_camera: independent still photographs; camera setup not applicable or recorded

classes.source_taxonomy: variant/family/manufacturer hierarchy of the main aircraft

annotation_capabilities.bbox_convention_stated: xmin ymin xmax ymax, top-left pixel is (1,1)
annotation_capabilities.bbox_convention_observed: 130 of 10,000 boxes have xmin or ymin equal to 0, which the stated 1-based convention does not allow
annotation_capabilities.banner: 20-pixel copyright banner at the bottom of every image; remove from model input, keep original-frame coordinates

discrepancies: Landing page and bundled README state 10,200 images/102 variants/41 manufacturers; the 2013b annotation files contain 10,000/100/30, matching the paper.

Published annotations MD5 e3799900175f63abbc48a5bc5b16427e does not match the served file (MD5 6939ddc41c731b6d5e82b20b2255f999, reproduced on two downloads); byte size matches the Content-Length. Integrity of the served file versus the authors' original is unresolved.
Landing page lists the annotations archive as 375 KB; served size is 407,927 bytes.

Both published .md5 files have Last-Modified 2014-01-17 17:28:19 GMT, earlier than the annotations archive (17:42:51) and the full archive (17:55:16); the published MD5s probably describe earlier builds, so the full-archive MD5 may not match either.
sources.width_bin_note: Box width xmax-xmin+1 in annotation pixels; minimum 94, median 1004. FGVC gives no tiny-object support.

availability_reason.md5_measured: 2.75 GB archive not downloaded in this metadata-only audit
availability_reason.sha256_measured: 2.75 GB archive not downloaded in this metadata-only audit

retrieval.instructions: Download into data/raw/fgvc-aircraft-2013b/ (Git-ignored). Verify the annotations archive against sha256_measured. For the full archive, record MD5 and SHA-256 before extraction; if the MD5 differs from the published value, log it as a discrepancy and pin the measured SHA-256 only after the owner approves, or the maintainers confirm the current file. Never commit images.

grouping.official_split: random image-level split after diversity selection (paper); not photographer- or event-isolated
grouping.leakage_risk: Same aircraft, photographer or event can appear in train and test. Treat FGVC scores as a smoke check only.

availability_reason.group_key: annotation files carry no photographer, event or airframe ID

availability_reason.pretraining_overlap: no pretrained detector selected yet (AERIS-006); check against the chosen model's training data

valid: recall of the annotated main aircraft at a stated IoU threshold
localization error of matched main-aircraft boxes
metric_policy.unmatched_detections: Detections not matched to the main-aircraft box are left unscored (neither true nor false positive): other aircraft in the photo are unlabeled.

sources.name: DUT Anti-UAV (detection and tracking)
sources.provenance: Zhao, Zhang, Li, Wang, IEEE T-ITS 2022, arXiv:2205.10851; archives on Google Drive and Baidu.

rights.terms_summary: Paper states the data 'will be released publicly for academic research'. No explicit dataset license found. The repository's Apache-2.0 license covers repository contents; the arXiv CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license covers the paper. Neither is a media redistribution grant.

classes.source_taxonomy: single class UAV (more than 35 UAV types)

annotation_capabilities.objects_per_image: detection: 10,109 boxes on 10,000 images; tracking: one target per sequence

availability_reason.timestamps: tracking archive format not inspected; paper does not state PTS
availability_reason.annotated_negative_frames: paper does not state whether target-absent frames are labeled
availability_reason.bbox_convention_stated: repository and paper do not document indexing or endpoints

artifacts.name: detection train/val/test and tracking img/gt archives

availability_reason.size_bytes: Google Drive/Baidu links publish no size

retrieval.instructions: Do not acquire for the aircraft MVP. If later needed as a UAV-domain reference, get written confirmation of permitted use, record SHA-256 of every archive, and keep it out of aircraft metrics.

grouping.official_split: authors' detection train/val/test; grouping of detection images by source video is not documented
grouping.leakage_risk: Detection images may come from related footage; not audited.

availability_reason.width_bin_support: box sizes not measured; archives not downloaded

sources.name: AERIS owned fixed-camera aircraft video pilot
sources.provenance: To be captured by, or explicitly licensed to, the project owner. See acquisition_plan.

rights.terms_summary: Owner-held rights required before capture or use; the license decision is open.

availability_reason.terms_url: no footage or license exists yet
availability_reason.commercial_use: depends on the owner's footage terms, undecided
availability_reason.redistribution_permitted: depends on the owner's footage terms, undecided

classes.source_taxonomy: aircraft (fixed-wing and rotorcraft) visible in frame

annotation_capabilities.bbox_convention_stated: AERIS contract v1: 0-based half-open original-frame pixels

retrieval.instructions: Store original media in data/raw/aeris-pilot/ (Git-ignored) and back it up privately. Record SHA-256 of encoded files and of decoded frames, plus container PTS, at ingest.

grouping.group_key: capture session ID (one location, one day, one camera setup)
grouping.leakage_risk: Adjacent frames and clips from the same session are correlated; split whole sessions only.

availability_reason.pretraining_overlap: not captured; false only for owner-captured footage recorded after detector weights are fixed; verify in AERIS-006

procedure: Assign whole source groups (capture session, or tracking sequence where no session is known) to one split before looking at model results.
Frames, clips and every derivative (crops, resizes, re-encodes, augmentations) inherit their group's split.
Run exact-duplicate checks across splits; any cross-split match moves the later group or is removed, and is logged.
Run the near-duplicate audit; reviewer decisions are logged with both file hashes.
Record per-split support for negatives and each width bin before any evaluation.
split_policy.holdout_rule: Holdout is opened only for release evaluation (AERIS-018); never used for threshold or model selection.
exact_duplicate_checks: sha256 of decoded RGB frame pixels

near_duplicate_audit.method: perceptual-hash candidate pairs across splits, then manual review

availability_reason.hamming_threshold: set in AERIS-003 from the measured hash-distance distribution of the acquired data, not guessed here

negatives.requirement: Each split must contain negative frames from at least one session; report their count per split. Partial or unlabeled frames never count as negatives.

tiny_objects.requirement: Report per-split, per-bin support in original-frame pixels. A bin with zero holdout support reports metrics as unavailable, never zero or pass.
tiny_objects.known_gap: FGVC provides no boxes under 64 px wide; tiny-target evidence must come from the video pilot.

split_policy.fgvc_use: Official splits kept as-is for a detection smoke check only; not eligible for the development regression set or holdout.
split_policy.interval_policy: With 2 holdout sessions (about 4 clips), sequence-bootstrap intervals are not informative. Holdout results are per-sequence and descriptive; AERIS-005 sets the minimum number of sequences for reporting intervals before any holdout result, otherwise intervals are null with a reason.

acquisition_plan.effort_basis: Engineering judgement assuming keyframe interpolation with per-frame review; not measured. Capture travel and waiting for rare events are excluded and may exceed the caps.
constraints: Owner-captured or explicitly licensed footage only; record the license before use.
Fixed tripod, fixed zoom, recorded RGB; note camera model, resolution and frame rate.
Capture from lawful public vantage points; follow local law and airport rules; do not identify people.
Raw media and annotations stay out of Git; commit only manifests, hashes and retrieval notes.
Stop when a cap is reached and report missing regimes instead of extending silently.
decisions_needed: Who captures or licenses the footage, and under which terms.
Capture locations and dates for at least six independent sessions.
Annotation tool (CVAT is a candidate) and export format mapped to contract v1.

availability_reason.review_sample_fraction: fixed and recorded before review starts, from the actual frame count
